offering_description.value: APi Group installs and services fire protection, electronic security, elevators and escalators for businesses and public institutions. Its field technicians inspect, test, monitor and maintain building systems. It also performs specialty construction and maintenance for utilities and industrial facilities.

primary_products.value: Fire alarm systems; fire sprinkler and suppression systems; portable fire extinguishers; access control systems; video surveillance systems

primary_services.value: Fire protection system installation, inspection and maintenance; electronic security installation and monitoring; elevator and escalator maintenance and modernization; utility infrastructure construction and repair; industrial plant contracting and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial property owners and managers, general contractors, utilities and industrial facility operators; B2G: Government agencies and public facility operators

end_markets.value: Commercial real estate; industrial facilities; utilities and infrastructure; healthcare; education

revenue_model.value: service fees: Recurring inspections, testing, monitoring, preventive maintenance and repairs; project or contract: System design and installation, elevator modernization, and utility and industrial construction; product sales: Fire extinguishers and fire protection and electronic security equipment
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Integrates equipment and supplies field labor for property owners, contractors, utilities and industrial operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Fire protection, electronic security, elevator and escalator services, and utility and industrial contracting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local branch sales and service teams, national account teams, and project bids to owners and general contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local fire and building codes, elevator inspection and contractor licensing requirements, and workplace safety rules

notes: The current mix of utility and industrial contracting activities is uncertain.
